summary: E2E for AestheticaMD PROMs new features: (1) Dashboard SurveyRemindersCard + GET /api/surveys/due; (2) Survey builder timepoint offsets + presets; (3) Pre/post trend chart in /surveys → Wyniki with patient chips & SCHNOS metric select. ALL PASS. Backend pytest 8/8 (test_surveys_due_offsets.py): offset migration verified for NOSE (pre=0, 90, 365) and all templates; /api/surveys/due returns 'Due Test' NOSE 3m overdue 10 days and excludes its pre+12m rows; API-created planned patient (surgery=today+5) assigned NOSE via POST /api/surveys/patients/{pid}/sync appears with pre-op row days_overdue=-5 and no post-op rows; patient with surgery=today+60 is NOT in /due; RBAC subset check for jan.kowalski (user-visible rows ⊆ admin rows, within allowed locations). UI: dashboard survey-reminders-card renders 'Test Due' in red with '10 dni po terminie', survey-overdue-count='1 zaległych', survey-due-count='1'; survey-due-copy-<id> triggers 'Link skopiowany – Test Due' toast; patient name navigates to /patients/<id> and PatientSurveysCard still works. Builder: NOSE edit shows offsets 0/90/365 for 3 timepoints; new survey add-timepoint-6m inserts offset=180, add-timepoint-custom inserts empty offset. Chart: survey-trend-chart visible with NOSE default; footer 'Przed zabiegiem: 100 (n=1)' from Ankieta Anna; chart-patient-select → chart-patient-chip-<pid> added (svg path count 2→4 confirms dashed line); chip click removes it; SCHNOS template reveals chart-metric-select with options 'Wynik całkowity / SCHNOS-O / SCHNOS-C'; results-timepoint-select hides chart on filter and 'Wszystkie momenty' restores it.
critical_code_review_comments: surveys.py /due: correct window logic — pre window 14, post window 7; pre-op suppressed after surgery_date; sorted by -days_overdue; location filter via get_patient_location_filter.
SurveyRemindersCard renders 'termin dziś'/'termin za N dni' negative-overdue copy and 'N dni po terminie' positive — spec match; styling red bg when overdue.

SurveyTrendChart: max 5 patient lines enforced in toggle(); maxY computed from first row's total.max or subscale.max — fine; connectNulls=true so a single pre-op datapoint still shows a dot. Minor: when a timepoint filter is active in ResultsTab the chart is hidden via parent gate (confirmed by UI test).

SurveyBuilderPage: timepoint-offset-{i} inputs rendered per row; presets add-timepoint-pre/1m/3m/6m/12m/custom supply correct offsets (0/30/90/180/365/empty). Save→reload persistence verified in a previous iteration; this iteration confirmed indexes stay stable while adding.
